title: Dispatch CTW 6: Bridge Damage Found after the Choir Falls Silent
summary: Railway officials credit the halt with preventing a derailment.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Inspectors found a cracked bearing under the bridge yesterday. The eastbound service was held at Alderwick while repairs began. At the hour it would have crossed, the choir sang a single sustained note and stopped.

Mr. Bell has reviewed the telegraph tapes. No living operator transmitted the warning. Dr. Saye says the old message may have found a new occasion on which it could be understood. She will not claim the voices knew of the crack before it formed.
